name: WYSIWYG RAD GUI Builder for Native Applications

mentions.name: WYSIWYG RAD GUI Builder for Native Applications
mentions.description: An old-school WYSIWYG rapid application development (RAD) GUI builder for building native applications.
mentions.problem: Native app development is unnecessarily painful, and the author rejects that it has to be that way.
mentions.source_excerpt: An old school WYSIWYG RAD GUI builder for native applications. Because I don't accept that native app development needs to suck as much as it does.
